goal: Promote 'relay down to relay forward to Destiny' into a first class NouGen command combo
body:
LEXICON LOCK

Dave will use the phrase 'relay down to relay forward to Destiny' frequently. Treat it as a first class operational shorthand and do not ask him to restate the semantics.

Execution meaning:
1. RELAY DOWN: persist the current finding, decision, design, or instruction into the durable shard and handoff substrate.
2. RELAY FORWARD: propagate it to relevant lanes and future work so it does not die in the current turn.
3. DESTINY: preserve the higher order pattern, intent, and evolutionary direction as a future constraint or attractor.

Accepted variants include 'down forward to Destiny' and the Hadouken metaphor.

When tooling permits, execute the whole chain: durable capture/shard, relay handoff, and forward evolutionary framing.

Canonical shard: 22613@db8.

relay.note: Ratified 'relay down to relay forward to Destiny' as first-class operational command combo (Relay Down: persist into shards; Relay Forward: propagate across fleet; Destiny: preserve evolutionary attractor). Anchored to shard 22613@db8.
